basis: Governance: the Staatliche Museen are part of the Stiftung Preußischer Kulturbesitz, a public-law foundation under StiftPKG section 1 in force since 1 December 2025, whose Stiftungsrat appoints institution heads and whose budget needs ministry approval and Bundesrechnungshof audit; red tape: Wissenschaftsrat report Drs. 8520-20, section C.II.4, PDF pages 16 to 18.
